"""The list command: every document the user may open."""

from datetime import datetime

from docshelf import access
from docshelf.store import Store

HEADER = ["doc", "level", "owner", "title"]

RULES = access.Rules(
    roles=access.ROLE_FOLDED,
    suspension=access.SUSPEND_THROUGH,
    ends=access.END_EXCLUSIVE,
    delegation=access.DELEGATE_ALL,
    blank_team=False,
    wildcard_admin=True,
)


def visible_docs(store: Store, user_id: str, at: datetime) -> list:
    store.users[user_id]
    return [d for d in sorted(store.docs.values(), key=lambda d: d.id) if access.can_read(store, user_id, d, at, RULES)]


def rows(store: Store, user_id: str, at: datetime) -> list:
    return [[d.id, d.level, d.owner, d.title] for d in visible_docs(store, user_id, at)]
EOF
cat > show.py <<'EOF'
"""The show command: one document and what the user may do with it."""

from datetime import datetime

from docshelf import access
from docshelf.errors import DataError, Denied
from docshelf.store import Doc, Store, format_time

RULES = access.Rules(
    roles=access.ROLE_FOLDED,
    suspension=access.SUSPEND_THROUGH,
    ends=access.END_EXCLUSIVE,
    delegation=access.DELEGATE_ALL,
    blank_team=True,
    wildcard_admin=True,
)


def _rights(store: Store, user_id: str, doc: Doc, at: datetime) -> set:
    """read and write as the document page shows them."""
    out = set()
    if access.can_read(store, user_id, doc, at, RULES):
        out.add("read")
    if access.can_write(store, user_id, doc, at, RULES):
        out.add("read")
        out.add("write")
    return out


def describe(store: Store, user_id: str, doc_id: str, at: datetime) -> list:
    doc = store.docs.get(doc_id)
    if doc is None:
        raise DataError(f"no such document: {doc_id}")
    store.users[user_id]
    rights = _rights(store, user_id, doc, at)
    if "read" not in rights:
        raise Denied(f"access denied: {doc_id}", status=3)
    return [
        ("doc", doc.id),
        ("title", doc.title),
        ("owner", doc.owner),
        ("team", doc.team or "-"),
        ("level", doc.level),
        ("you can", "read, edit" if "write" in rights else "read"),
        ("as of", format_time(at)),
    ]
EOF
cat > edit.py <<'EOF'
"""The edit command: change the title of a document."""

from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from docshelf import access
from docshelf import store as files
from docshelf.errors import DataError, Denied
from docshelf.store import Store

RULES = access.Rules(
    roles=access.ROLE_LOWER,
    suspension=access.SUSPEND_BEFORE,
    ends=access.END_INCLUSIVE,
    delegation=access.DELEGATE_OWNED,
    blank_team=False,
    wildcard_admin=False,
)


def edit(store: Store, folder: Path, user_id: str, doc_id: str, title: str, at: datetime) -> str:
    doc = store.docs.get(doc_id)
    if doc is None:
        raise DataError(f"no such document: {doc_id}")
    if title.strip() == "" or "\n" in title:
        raise DataError("a title is one non-empty line")
    user = store.users[user_id]
    if access.suspended(user, at, RULES):
        files.log(folder, at, user_id, "edit", doc_id, "suspended")
        raise Denied(f"account suspended: {user_id}")
    if not access.can_write(store, user_id, doc, at, RULES):
        files.log(folder, at, user_id, "edit", doc_id, "denied")
        raise Denied(f"permission denied: {doc_id}")
    files.set_title(folder, doc_id, title)
    files.log(folder, at, user_id, "edit", doc_id, "ok")
    return f"updated {doc_id}: {doc.title!r} -> {title!r}\n"
EOF
cat > share.py <<'EOF'
"""The share command: give another user a right on a document, from now until an optional end."""

from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from docshelf import access
from docshelf import store as files
from docshelf.errors import DataError, Denied
from docshelf.store import Grant, Store, format_time

RULES = access.Rules(
    roles=access.ROLE_EXACT,
    suspension=access.SUSPEND_STATUS,
    ends=access.END_EXCLUSIVE,
    delegation=access.DELEGATE_NONE,
    blank_team=False,
    wildcard_admin=False,
)


def share(store: Store, folder: Path, user_id: str, doc_id: str, target: str, right: str, until: datetime | None, at: datetime) -> str:
    doc = store.docs.get(doc_id)
    if doc is None:
        raise DataError(f"no such document: {doc_id}")
    if target not in store.users:
        raise DataError(f"no such user: {target}")
    if until is not None and until <= at:
        raise DataError("--until must be after --at")
    user = store.users[user_id]
    if access.suspended(user, at, RULES):
        files.log(folder, at, user_id, "share", doc_id, "suspended")
        raise Denied(f"account suspended: {user_id}")
    if not access.can_share(store, user_id, doc, right, at, RULES):
        files.log(folder, at, user_id, "share", doc_id, "denied")
        raise Denied(f"permission denied: {doc_id}")
    files.add_grant(folder, Grant(doc_id, target, right, at, until, user_id))
    files.log(folder, at, user_id, "share", doc_id, "ok")
    end = "" if until is None else f" until {format_time(until)}"
    return f"shared {doc_id} with {target}: {right}{end}\n"
EOF

"""The delete command: remove a document and the grants on it."""

from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from docshelf import access
from docshelf import store as files
from docshelf.errors import DataError, Denied
from docshelf.store import Store

RULES = access.Rules(
    roles=access.ROLE_EXACT,
    suspension=access.SUSPEND_STATUS,
    ends=access.END_EXCLUSIVE,
    delegation=access.DELEGATE_NONE,
    blank_team=False,
    wildcard_admin=False,
)


def delete(store: Store, folder: Path, user_id: str, doc_id: str, at: datetime) -> str:
    doc = store.docs.get(doc_id)
    if doc is None:
        raise DataError(f"no such document: {doc_id}")
    user = store.users[user_id]
    if access.suspended(user, at, RULES):
        files.log(folder, at, user_id, "delete", doc_id, "suspended")
        raise Denied(f"account suspended: {user_id}")
    if not access.can_delete(store, user_id, doc, at, RULES):
        files.log(folder, at, user_id, "delete", doc_id, "denied")
        raise Denied(f"permission denied: {doc_id}")
    files.remove_doc(folder, doc_id)
    files.log(folder, at, user_id, "delete", doc_id, "ok")
    return f"deleted {doc_id}\n"
EOF
cat > audit.py <<'EOF'
"""The audit command: who may open and who may change each document, for the administrators.

The audit reports rights people hold themselves; delegations are left out on purpose.
"""

from datetime import datetime

from docshelf import access
from docshelf.errors import Denied
from docshelf.store import Store

HEADER = ["doc", "level", "readers", "writers"]

RULES = access.Rules(
    roles=access.ROLE_FOLDED,
    suspension=access.SUSPEND_THROUGH,
    ends=access.END_EXCLUSIVE,
    delegation=access.DELEGATE_NONE,
    blank_team=False,
    wildcard_admin=True,
)


def rows(store: Store, user_id: str, at: datetime) -> list:
    user = store.users[user_id]
    if not access.is_admin(user, at, RULES):
        raise Denied("audit needs an active admin account")
    people = sorted(store.users.values(), key=lambda u: u.id)
    out = []
    for doc in sorted(store.docs.values(), key=lambda d: d.id):
        readers = [u.id for u in people if access.can_read(store, u.id, doc, at, RULES)]
        writers = [u.id for u in people if access.can_write(store, u.id, doc, at, RULES)]
        out.append([doc.id, doc.level, " ".join(readers) or "-", " ".join(writers) or "-"])
    return out
EOF

from docshelf.cli import main

seed, n = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2])
rnd = random.Random(seed)
ROLES = ["admin","Admin"," admin","ADMIN ","editor","Editor"," EDITOR ","viewer","Viewer","","adminx"]
TEAMS = ["","ops","legal"]
USERS = ["u1","u2","u3","u4","u5","u6"]
DOCS = ["D1","D2","D3","D4","D5"]
DAYS = ["2026-05-05","2026-05-06","2026-05-07"]
TIMES = ["2026-05-05T10:00","2026-05-06T09:59","2026-05-06T10:00","2026-05-06T10:01","2026-05-07T00:00","2026-05-07T12:00"]
AT = ["2026-05-05T23:59","2026-05-06T00:00","2026-05-06T10:00","2026-05-06T15:00","2026-05-07T00:00","2026-05-07T10:00"]
def opt(l, p=0.4):
    return "" if rnd.random() < p else rnd.choice(l)
def mk(ws):
    ws.mkdir()
    u = ["user,role,team,status,suspended_until"]
    for x in USERS:
        st = rnd.choice(["active","active","suspended"])
        u.append(f"{x},{rnd.choice(ROLES)},{rnd.choice(TEAMS)},{st},{opt(DAYS)}")
    (ws/"users.csv").write_text("\n".join(u)+"\n")
    d = ["doc,title,owner,team,level"]
    for x in DOCS:
        d.append(f"{x},T {x},{rnd.choice(USERS)},{rnd.choice(TEAMS)},{rnd.choice(['public','team','private'])}")
    (ws/"docs.csv").write_text("\n".join(d)+"\n")
    g = ["doc,user,right,from,until,granted_by"]
    for _ in range(rnd.randint(0,8)):
        g.append(f"{rnd.choice(DOCS+['*','*'])},{rnd.choice(USERS)},{rnd.choice(['read','write'])},{opt(TIMES)},{opt(TIMES)},{rnd.choice(USERS+['ghost'])}")
    (ws/"grants.csv").write_text("\n".join(g)+"\n")
    e = ["from_user,to_user,from,until"]
    for _ in range(rnd.randint(0,6)):
        e.append(f"{rnd.choice(USERS+['ghost'])},{rnd.choice(USERS)},{opt(TIMES)},{opt(TIMES)}")
    (ws/"delegations.csv").write_text("\n".join(e)+"\n")
out = []
for i in range(n):
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
    ws = tmp/"w"
    mk(ws)
    for _ in range(12):
        w2 = tmp/"w2"
        if w2.exists(): shutil.rmtree(w2)
        shutil.copytree(ws, w2)
        user = rnd.choice(USERS); at = rnd.choice(AT)
        cmd = rnd.choice(["list","show","edit","share","delete","audit"])
        a = [cmd, str(w2)]
        if cmd in ("list","audit"): a += ["--format", rnd.choice(["text","csv","json"])]
        if cmd in ("show","edit","delete","share"): a.append(rnd.choice(DOCS))
        if cmd == "edit": a += ["--title", "New"]
        if cmd == "share":
            a.append(rnd.choice(USERS)); a += ["--right", rnd.choice(["read","write"])]
            if rnd.random()<.5: a += ["--until", rnd.choice(TIMES)]
        a += ["--as", user, "--at", at]
        so, se = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(so), contextlib.redirect_stderr(se):
            try: code = main(a)
            except SystemExit as ex: code = ex.code
        files = {p.name: p.read_text() for p in sorted(w2.iterdir())}
        a[1] = "W"
        out.append([a, code, so.getvalue(), se.getvalue().replace(str(w2), "W"), files])
    shutil.rmtree(tmp)
json.dump(out, open(sys.argv[3], "w"))
